data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using an 8-stage pipeline chart
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown with a line chart
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance metrics
SOLID principles are represented in the chart
Chart is clear and easy to interpret

features.title: Results Presentation
features.description: Show real metrics from recent runs to demonstrate Artemis capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are accurate and up-to-date
Data is presented in a clear and concise manner
Charts are used to enhance understanding of results

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents integration data
Chart is interactive and visually appealing
Data is sourced from recent runs

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls for the slides.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance at a set interval
Navigation controls allow manual slide progression
Auto-advance can be paused and resumed

features.title: HTML Presentation Setup
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: Single HTML file contains all necessary CSS and JavaScript
Chart.js library is included and functional
File is located at /tmp/artemis_demo_chartjs.html

features.title: HERO Slide Content
features.description: Introduce Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System in the HERO slide.
acceptance_criteria: HERO slide clearly explains Artemis
Content is engaging and informative
Slide design matches overall presentation style

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Apply a professional gradient background and smooth transitions to the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied consistently across slides
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional
Design aligns with existing demos as templates
